note: P4338 (Pro 29:1) — he who is often reproved yet stiffens his neck will suddenly be broken beyond healing.

dims.v: incorrigible obstinacy — hardening against repeated reproof
the stiffening of the neck against repeated reproof — the incorrigible obstinacy that refuses every correction and so is suddenly broken beyond all healing, hardness set past the point of rescue
the stubborn refusal of correction that ends in sudden, unhealable ruin

qashah (harden/stiffen) — 'he who is often reproved, yet STIFFENS his neck, will suddenly be broken beyond healing'; the man who hardens against every rebuke destroys his last hope of rescue. Obstinacy repeatedly refusing correction breaks all at once, past mending (cf 28:14; 6:15).
